availability: Published about 09:00 America/New_York next Reserve Bank business day; revisions possible. This download is revised historical costs, never an available-at-time feature.
cost_interpolation: Effective-date UTC midnight, stepwise constant until next effective date including closed days, end coverage 2026-07-01T00:00Z. Ex-post cost convention, not publication-time predictor.
coverage_policy: Require exact expected business dates, unique finite observations. Stop for any mismatch; do not fill missing business dates.
frequency: Reserve Bank business dates; Sunday holidays move to Monday; Saturday does not move to Friday; Juneteenth from 2021
methodology_break: EFFR source and calculation changed effective 2016-03-01; series continuity is a financing proxy assumption, not uniform historical methodology.
purpose: Historical financing cost proxy only; never predictor or as-of macro input
schema_repair: Official YAML advertises percent; received immutable JSON uses percentRate. Correct explicit mapping; no alias fallback or second download.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, direct Markets Data API
